messages:
ash: noticing p99 jump from ~120ms -> ~980ms on prod for model-eta, started ~13:02 UTC. dashboard: https://redwood.prod/metrics/model-eta
incident-bot: INCIDENT P2 - latency spike detected on serving runtime (region: us-east)
sre_oncall: joining, what's the scope? p50 stable, p99 spiking, throughput down ~30%
glenn: traces look noisy - selector churn with frequent kernel switch calls, kernel init latency high. flamegraph: https://flame.redwood/xyz
maria: profiler shows heavy memcpy and setup cost on quantized-kernel path. batch window drifting to 40-60ms under burst
ash: traffic is lots of short sequences (single-token-ish) so batching heuristics are creating many fragile small batches then flushes
jon: KV shard miss rate jumped 3% -> 25% at the same time, cold entries being rehydrated which amplifies backend work
ash: hypothesis: autoswitch triggers late for short batches -> kernel init + kv misses amplify tail
glenn: proposed mitigations (quick): 1) shrink batch_window_ms 30 -> 8, 2) pin kernel variant for model-eta via feature flag, 3) bump KV warmup TTL to 5m, 4) soft-throttle high-qps tenant if needed
sre_oncall: I can flip the flag and add tenant throttle; will coordinate router changes
ash: feature flag created: `feature/selector_pin/model-eta=stable` -> enabling to 20% canary now
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-toggle @ash -> canary rollout starting (20%) ; rollout plan: 20% -> 100% in 5m if no regressions
jon: routing change: `routing.weight(model-eta-fallback)=0.3` applied, fallback route (quantized small-batch path) enabled
maria: batch window reduced on pool-12 (`batch_window_ms=8`), early signal: p99 dropped to ~180ms immediately
sre_oncall: KV warmup TTL bumped, cache-mgr running targeted warming for hot prefixes
glenn: post-mitigation numbers at 13:15 UTC: p99 ~160ms, throughput recovered to ~92% baseline
ash: still occasional 600ms spikes — looks like a noisy tenant causing microbursts. recommend temporary tenant cap
sre_oncall: tenant cap applied for tenant-omega -> 500rps soft limit, monitor for backpressure effects
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - mitigations applied. Monitoring window 30m, alert on p99 > 300ms or throughput < 80%
maria: collecting artifacts: flamegraphs, perf logs, and profiler snapshots saved to /incidents/2261112223/artifacts
glenn: follow-ups: improve autoswitch latency budget (avoid late switch for short-batches), add prefetch/warmup for short-seq bursts, refine batch-shaping algorithms for single-token dominated traffic
ash: taking ownership of postmortem writeup. short root cause: selector autoswitch latency + KV coldstart amplification under short-seq workload
sre_oncall: will close incident after stable 30m window, otherwise escalate to P1
ash: thanks team :thumbsup:
